description: Epoch AI 'ai-chip-counts' github repo data — chip-count timelines, cumulative totals, and owner breakdowns by designer (NVIDIA/AMD/TPU/Trainium and others).

body.how_to_read: 51 CSVs (sample in files_sample; full list = `ls data/blobs/epoch/ai_chip_counts/`): per-designer chip timelines, cumulative-by-chip, cumulative totals, and owner breakdowns for NVIDIA, AMD, TPU, Trainium, plus some company revenue tables. Directly relevant to AI-chip volumes by designer. Columns vary per file — read the header.

methodology.summary: Data CSVs from the epoch-research/ai-chip-counts repo, copied to blobs on 2026-06-12 (CSV-only). Confidence 0.8 (CC BY 4.0).
